usage: cli.py strategy-brief [-h] --as-of AS_OF --brief BRIEF
                             --brief-meta BRIEF_META --earnings EARNINGS
                             --earnings-meta EARNINGS_META
                             --catalysts CATALYSTS
                             --catalysts-meta CATALYSTS_META --out OUT
                             [--meta-out META_OUT] [--render-md RENDER_MD]
                             [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--cache-only]
                             [--refresh] [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --as-of AS_OF         As-of date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --brief BRIEF         Brief JSON path
  --brief-meta BRIEF_META
                        Brief meta JSON path
  --earnings EARNINGS   Earnings JSONL path
  --earnings-meta EARNINGS_META
                        Earnings meta JSON path
  --catalysts CATALYSTS
                        Catalysts JSONL path
  --catalysts-meta CATALYSTS_META
                        Catalysts meta JSON path
  --out OUT             Output strategy JSON path
  --meta-out META_OUT   Optional output strategy meta JSON path
  --render-md RENDER_MD
                        Optional output strategy markdown path
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory
  --cache-only          Fail if cache is missing; do not recompute.
  --refresh             Recompute even if cache exists.
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
